subject: Activation sweep and exception contingency planning
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Activation sweep and exception contingency planning

Team —

As we move toward the Oct 22 activation window I want to lock the sweep plan and capture any launch exceptions that require escalation. High-level asks:
- Confirm owner for enablement playbook and customer-facing onboarding guide.
- Call out any customers with unique network/security requirements (we already have a small list).
- List any training/CS capacity gaps for the first two post-activation weeks.
- Flag contract/procurement items that need SLAs or marketplace coordination.

Attached is a draft activation runbook (redwood-activation-runbook-draft.pdf). Please respond with short bullets — owners + blockers — by EOD Friday, Oct 5. If you have a procurement/security request, attach an evidence stub or note and I'll pull in legal/security.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Folks —

Heads-up: Atlas Health submitted a formal security exception request this morning — forward of their email below. Summary: they require a private VPC deployment and an extended 24x7 support SLA for their first 30 days due to PHI handling. Legal/procurement will likely want to see the customer questionnaire + SOC 2 evidence before we can commit.

Forwarded message:
From: Atlas Health <atlas-ops@atlashealth.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, Oct 4, 2028 at 07:12 AM
Subject: Prod onboarding security ask

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick call. To proceed with production onboarding we need:
1) Private VPC deployment (peering or private link).
2) 24x7 support SLA for the first 30 days after go-live.
3) SOC 2 Type II report and network diagrams.

Can you confirm whether those are possible and provide an estimated timeline?

Best,
R. Alvarez
Atlas Health — Technical Ops

----
Kimberly continued:

Implications: if we agree to a private deployment we need a short timeline impact (likely +7 to +10 days for network setup) and to engage Dedicated/Private infra. Marcus — I'd like you to take point on SLA negotiation and estimate infra lead time.

I've attached their request as sla-exception-request-atlas.pdf. Legal/procurement will need to see the questionnaire and SOC2 snapshots; I can request those materials from Security tomorrow if you want me to.

Kimberly
Director, Customer Security

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Date: 2028-10-05T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Activation sweep and exception contingency planning — consolidated decisions and next steps

Thanks for the quick turn here. Consolidated decisions / owners and immediate actions: 

1) Docs & Playbook
- Owner: Laura Bennett (onboarding guide). Laura will partner with Marcus for telemetry content. Deliverable: final onboarding guide v1.0 (customer-facing) by Oct 12.
2) Enablement & Training
- Trainers: Priyom leads live sessions Oct 23 & 25. Marcus is backup. Priyom to publish attendee list and slide deck by Oct 16.
3) Atlas Health exception (private deployment + SLA)
- Owner: Marcus Lin (SLA engagement). Action: Marcus to confirm infra lead time and post a timeline to RI-1428 by EOD Oct 6. Kimberly to kick off evidence request (SOC2/network diagrams).
4) Timeline impact
- If Atlas requires private VPC, add contingency window of +7–10 days to activation for that customer only; platform-wide activation remains Oct 22 unless additional exceptions surface.
5) Procurement/Legal
- Vivek will open an expedited procurement thread internally and loop Legal if the customer asks for contract redlines; DocuSign envelope linked for any expedited SLA sign-off.

Please reply only if you disagree with owners or dates. Otherwise assume these are confirmed and I'll coordinate the internal readiness huddle next Wednesday (Oct 11).

Attachments referenced: redwood-activation-runbook-draft.pdf, enablement-checklist-v2.xlsx, sla-exception-request-atlas.pdf

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
